summary: Institutional positioning is heavily skewed toward long-term bullishness on the broad market, evidenced by massive $1B+ accumulations in SPX 7000C contracts expiring late 2026. While QQQ shows short-term bearishness (P/C 2.33), the dominant conviction lies in massive, multi-day persistent buying of SPX 7000C strikes (exp 2026-09-18 and 2026-12-18) totaling billions in premium. High-conviction single-stock bullishness is concentrated in the semiconductor space, specifically NVDA (P/C 0.20) and MU (P/C 0.31), alongside DELL. Traders should watch for continued upward momentum in SPX and semi-cap stocks, but monitor for any reversal in the QQQ/SPY put flow which suggests immediate-term hedging or localized tech weakness.
